decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Location Plan, BV492-01, Mitsubishi PUMY-P R410A Inverter Heat Pump Product Information, Daikin Compact VRV IV heat pumps brochure, photographs and Fire Safety Statement. Received: 11/04/2025 
DR1421 and PEACEFLOW300 product information. Received: 24/05/2025
Noise Impact Assessment IMP7815-2. Received: 02/06/2025
Unnumbered Proposed Elevation. Received: 13/08/2025
Unnumbered existing ground floor plan and unnumbered proposed ground floor plan. Received: 15/08/2025
Design & Access Statement v2. Received: 09/09/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which this permission refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the plant operate. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or one metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142. An alternative position for assessment/measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria are achieved. 

b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.   

c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review. If the plant fails to meet the specified standard, remedial measures shall be put in place immediately and the noise assessment shall be carried out again.  This shall be repeated until the assessment has reached the required standard.  Once achieved, the plant shall be maintained permanently ther

Condition : 4 - The plant equipment hereby approved shall only operate between the hours of 8:00-18:00 Mondays to Saturdays and 09:00-17:00 Sundays and Public/Bank Holidays. 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring residential premises are not adversely affected by noise.

Condition : 5 - The acoustic louvre screens as shown in the submitted documents and detailed on page 10 of the "Industrial Noise Impact Assessment" by 'Impact Acoustics' (Ref: IMP7815-2), shall remain in the closed position at all times that the plant equipment is in operation, other than during servicing and maintenance of the plant equipment.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from operation of the plant equipment.
